create_example_from_json: create an Example from a JSON string using the fromJSON class method with fields config
create_example_from_dict: create an Example from a Python dictionary using the fromdict class method with fields config
create_example_from_csv: create an Example from CSV row data using the fromCSV class method with optional field index mapping
create_example_from_list: create an Example from a list of values using the fromlist class method with fields config
create_example_from_tree: create an Example from an NLTK parse tree string using the fromtree class method with subtrees option
